In SA2#122bis, SA2 considered conditional conclusions for the FeD2D study item. In addition, they concerns with key issues and demand RAN2 to resolve these issues [1][2]. In this contribution, we investigated the concerned 7 key issues from SA2. We summarized observation and feasible responses based on the completed RAN2 SI. Then, we reviewed RAN2 impacts and suggest proposals regarding the each issue.
